purpose: Editable geometry/dynamics demonstration inputs for original V6; not physical certification, measured inertial identification, validated grip rating, motor thermal rating or print-strength analysis.

cad_geometry_provenance.native_extractor: work/v6/extract_body_mass.py: IBody2.GetMassProperties(1.0), first single solid body in each native part
cad_geometry_provenance.geometry_scope: Exact native-solid integrals for the modeled shapes, subject to CAD model and single-body extraction assumptions. Reference hardware is simplified CAD geometry.
cad_geometry_provenance.products_to_tensor: Negate each SW product of inertia: tensor off-diagonals Ixy=-mp[9], Ixz=-mp[10], Iyz=-mp[11]. Diagonals mp[6:9]. Central tensor axes are native part axes.
cad_geometry_provenance.independent_sign_check: Waist turntable source STL integrated with trimesh at unit density after mm-to-m conversion agrees in moments within tessellation differences and has off-diagonal signs opposite SW reported products.

units_and_frames.COM_inertia_frame: Native CAD part coordinate frame; COM in m, central inertia in kg*m^2.
units_and_frames.STL_warning: Existing Print_STL coordinates are mm AND some files are translated into the positive octant. A .001 scale alone is insufficient. Prefer direct STEP remeshing in native coordinates or explicitly restore the STL origin with independent verification.

profiles.source_scenario: Use source_scenario_mass_kg and source_scenario_central_inertia_kg_m2 to reproduce old V6 homogeneous material and hardware proxy calculation, including nonphysical spring clearance annuli.
profiles.geometry_demo: Recommended for the geometry-first viewer: use demo_mass_kg and demo_central_inertia_kg_m2. Identical material/hardware proxies, but the spring clearance-envelope masses are explicitly omitted. This omission is not a claim that real springs are massless. No quantitative hardware-capacity conclusions follow.
profiles.editable_calibration: For a measured component mass m, use I=unit_density_central_inertia*(m/unit_density_mass) only as a homogeneous-shape assumption. Measured mass alone does not establish COM or inertia of an infilled print/motor. Override COM and tensor separately when identified.

aggregation_for_MJCF.transform_to_link: Transform each component COM and central tensor into its assigned rigid-link frame before combining. Let B_link denote that frame in world: c_link=B_link.T@(c_world-origin_link); I_link=B_link.T@I_world@B_link.
aggregation_for_MJCF.parallel_axis: M=sum(m_i); c=sum(m_i*c_i)/M; I=sum(I_i + m_i*((r_i dot r_i)*eye(3)-outer(r_i,r_i))), r_i=c_i-c.
aggregation_for_MJCF.MJCF_inertial: pos=c; mass=M; fullinertia=[Ixx,Iyy,Izz,Ixy,Ixz,Iyz], central tensor expressed in body axes; do not negate already converted tensor off-diagonals again.
aggregation_for_MJCF.positive_definiteness: Require each moving link M>0, finite symmetric I, positive eigenvalues and lambda_max<=lambda_mid+lambda_min within roundoff. Parallel-axis aggregation of positive component masses and positive definite central tensors preserves positive definiteness. Reject a failed audit rather than silently clamping inertias.
aggregation_for_MJCF.do_not_double_count: Use explicit body inertials and compiler inertiafromgeom=false; visual/collision geoms do not contribute additional mass. Massless omitted-envelope geoms must remain attached to a positively massive parent body; do not create an unconstrained moving body containing only omitted envelopes.
aggregation_for_MJCF.fixed_base: Fixture/base can be world-fixed. Their displayed scenario mass must not be included in a moving joint body unless physically moving.

not_identified.instruction: Any simulation gains, damping, contact friction or return springs chosen to keep a demo stable must be labeled tunable simulation assumptions, not actual measured hardware. Published stall torque and arbitrary fractions of it are not continuous ratings; do not convert them into certified actuator force ranges or load capacity.

audit_summary.mass_total_note: Scenario totals only, not actual weighed arm masses. Level -1 includes fixed external plywood and base. Finger kinematic regrouping must be done by the converter, not inferred solely from level 3.
